first_error_behavior: Save stops at the first of three narrow checks. Validate runs in source order and returns at the first active failure; modal/change handlers can alert and mutate fields earlier.

rules.condition: Any taxpayer TIN segment or branch code is blank.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid TIN number on Item 4.
rules.official_behavior: Save checks nonblankness only.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Permit lossless drafts; require shape/checksum for finalization.

rules.condition: Taxpayer RDO value equals literal 000.
rules.accepted_behavior: Any other value, including blank, passes.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid RDO Code on Item 5.
rules.official_behavior: Blank can pass this equality-only check.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require a valid catalog RDO before finalization.

rules.condition: Taxpayer name is blank.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid Taxpayer Name on Item 8.
rules.official_behavior: The first active branch alerts and returns.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured field error.

rules.condition: Any other field is invalid or incomplete.
rules.accepted_behavior: Save proceeds after three narrow checks.
rules.official_behavior: Draft validation is intentionally incomplete.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Preserve drafts losslessly and show completeness separately.

rules.condition: Return year is blank.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid year in Item 1.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: Short-period Yes and return year exceeds current system year.
rules.exact_message: Invalid date entry on Item #1. Since Short Return Period is Yes, valid year entry is only until current year.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: Not short-period and return year exceeds current system year.
rules.exact_message: Invalid date entry on Item #1. Year entry cannot be greater than to the current year.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: Return year is below 2018.
rules.exact_message: Please file using the old version of the form.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: Any taxpayer TIN component or branch is blank.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid TIN number on Item 4.
rules.official_behavior: No taxpayer checksum is called by Validate.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Validate taxpayer TIN checksum as well as shape.

rules.condition: A taxpayer TIN segment length is not 3 or branch length is below 3.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid TIN number on Item 4.
rules.official_behavior: Branch has a minimum but no maximum in this branch.

rules.condition: Taxpayer RDO selectedIndex is zero.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid RDO Code on Item 5.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: Taxpayer name is blank.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid Taxpayer Name on Item 8.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: Registered address is blank.
rules.exact_message: Please enter Taxpayer's Registered Address on Item 9.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: Birth date is blank.
rules.exact_message: Please indicate Birth Date of Taxpayer on item 10.
rules.official_behavior: Returns true rather than a consistent bare return; caller behavior still stops.

rules.condition: Birth date helper rejects the nonblank value.
rules.official_behavior: Helper emits one of two message forms.

rules.condition: ZIP code is blank.
rules.exact_message: Please enter Zip Code on Item 9A.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: Joint filing is selected and any spouse TIN segment is blank.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid TIN number on Item 66.
rules.official_behavior: Branch code is not required here.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require the complete spouse TIN shape for joint filing.

rules.condition: Any spouse TIN segment is present and a segment length is not 3 or branch length exceeds 5.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid TIN number on Item 66.
rules.official_behavior: Blank spouse branch passes; only an upper bound is checked.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require the exact branch-code shape when spouse TIN is present.

rules.condition: Spouse TIN checksum helper returns nonzero.
rules.exact_message: dynamic: getChkTinErrDesc(tinChkCode) + " on Item 66."
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: Spouse TIN is present and spouse RDO selectedIndex is zero.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid RDO Code on Item 67.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: Spouse TIN is present and spouse name is blank.
rules.exact_message: Please enter Spouse Name on Item 70.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: Spouse TIN is present and no spouse ATC is selected.
rules.exact_message: Please select an option for Item 69.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: No taxpayer type is selected.
rules.exact_message: Please select an option for Item 6.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: No taxpayer ATC is selected.
rules.exact_message: Please select an option for Item 7.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: No taxpayer tax rate is selected.
rules.exact_message: Please select an option for Item 19.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: Spouse name is nonblank and no spouse taxpayer type is selected.
rules.exact_message: Please select an option for Item 68.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: Spouse name is nonblank and no spouse ATC is selected.
rules.exact_message: Please select an option for Item 69.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: Aggregate Item 30 is negative and no overpayment choice is selected.
rules.exact_message: Please select an Overpayment option in Page 1 after Item 30.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops ordered validation.

rules.condition: All active validation branches pass.
rules.accepted_behavior: Controls disable and success alert appears.
rules.exact_message: Validation successful. Click on Edit if you wish to modify your entries.
rules.official_behavior: The first active branch alerts and returns.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured field error.

rules.condition: Birth date does not split into exactly three slash-separated components.
rules.exact_message: Invalid birthdate.Format should be MM/DD/YYYY
rules.official_behavior: The message omits a space after the period.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use strict date parsing and clearer wording.

rules.condition: Month/day/year range or leap-day check fails.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid date in Item 10.
rules.official_behavior: No minimum year or full future-date comparison; nonnumeric components can evade numeric comparisons.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use strict non-future calendar-date parsing with a reasonable minimum.

rules.condition: Taxpayer Item 53A exceeds 3,000,000.
rules.rejected_behavior: Item 53A resets to zero and both 8% ATCs clear.
rules.exact_message: Your Gross Sales/Receipts and Other Non-Operating Income exceeds VAT Threshold (P3M), thus, not qualified to 8% tax rate and shall be subjected to graduated rates. Please choose ATC and fill in Schedule IV.A if method of Deduction is OSD. Otherwise, use BIR Form 1701.
rules.official_behavior: P3M threshold is hard-coded.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Apply the threshold effective for the filing period.

rules.condition: Spouse Item 53B exceeds 3,000,000.
rules.rejected_behavior: Item 53B resets and both spouse 8% ATCs clear.
rules.exact_message: Your Gross Sales/Receipts and Other Non-Operating Income exceeds VAT Threshold (P3M), thus, not qualified to 8% tax rate and shall be subjected to graduated rates. Please choose ATC and fill in Schedule IV.A if method of Deduction is OSD. Otherwise, use BIR Form 1701.
rules.official_behavior: P3M threshold is hard-coded.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Apply the threshold effective for the filing period.

rules.condition: Item 54A exceeds 250,000.
rules.exact_message: Item 54A cannot be more than P250,000.
rules.official_behavior: The first active branch alerts and returns.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured field error.

rules.condition: Item 54B exceeds 250,000.
rules.exact_message: Item 54B cannot be more than P250,000.
rules.official_behavior: The first active branch alerts and returns.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured field error.

rules.condition: A materialized modal row description is blank unless maxLength equals 25.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid Description
rules.official_behavior: Validation is bypassed solely when maxLength equals 25.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Always require description for materialized rows.

rules.condition: Applicable modal amount columns compare <= 0 under the row-width/party branch.
rules.exact_message: Amount should not be zero.
rules.official_behavior: The code compares booleans to strings in isTaxpayerDisabled branches, making conditions difficult to reach as intended.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use explicit boolean conditions and parsed amounts.

rules.condition: Short-period Yes is selected.
rules.accepted_behavior: User acknowledges and chooses the last return-period month.
rules.exact_message: Choosing 'YES' means you are filing for a short period return. You are required to change the Month field to correspond with your Last Return Period.
rules.official_behavior: The first active branch alerts and returns.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured field error.

rules.condition: Final Copy is requested.
rules.rejected_behavior: Connectivity or confirmation can stop it.
rules.official_behavior: Final copy remains coupled to transport/connectivity.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Separate deterministic offline finalization from submission.

rules.condition: Online send is invoked.
rules.official_behavior: Source-derived only.

rules.condition: The HTA loads ../js/gserializer.js.
rules.rejected_behavior: In this extracted package it is absent; browser load fails for that resource.
rules.official_behavior: Missing linked resource is tolerated because required behavior is implemented elsewhere.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Do not depend on the missing script; retain the defect in compatibility evidence.
